caption: The drawing features a vertical rectangular composition bordered by uneven orange-brown strips on either side. At the top center, there are red roses with green leaves on a vine that curves rightward. Beneath the roses, a rooster with brown, red, blue, and white feathers stands among yellow stalks of wheat on a mound. Below, there is a decorative blue and gold scroll-like element, with a central urn-shaped vase containing stylized red and pink flowers on leafy green vines that extend outward. Directly below the vase is an octagonal frame with a white goat or lamb reclining inside it. Surrounding this lower section are green garlands with small white flowers draped in a semicircle. The drawing is set against a beige background, and finer black lines add detail throughout the composition. In the lower right corner, there is a small handwritten signature or inscription.
title: Wall Painting
